mh2_legends.note: Editorial feature (not story fiction). Re-fetched and string-checked 2026-10-30 ~02:20 CDT; already cited by Pack A2 claim A018.

method: Each Wizards page fetched 2026-10-30 ~02:10-02:20 CDT; article text extracted and every 'Bolas' mention read in context. Mention counts are case-sensitive matches of 'Bolas' in the extracted article text. Quoted phrases were string-matched against the extracted text.

reviews.finding: Bolas's first-person narration lists only four survivors ('only Chromium Rhuell, Arcades Sabboth, Palladia-Mors, and that vexatious beast Vaevictis Asmadi had survived'). Correction (2026-10-30 ~02:20 CDT): an independent Wizards editorial source does exist and was already recorded in Pack A2 (A018): the Modern Horizons 2 legends feature says 'Piru and Chromium were among the very few Elder Dragons who survived the Elder Dragon War instigated by Nicol Bolas.' Piru is absent from Bolas's list, so Wizards sources themselves disagree on the roster; the earlier statement that no independent Wizards source was located was wrong. Labelled non-Wizards secondary sources also disagree on the count (mtg.wiki: 'only seven'; CoolStuffInc 2018: five survivors including Bolas). The dispute is retained.

Bolas's claim to be 'the first among all sapient creatures' to planeswalk is still narrator-only. The Unwritten Now adds a further perspective conflict about sparks: Ugin says his spark 'came to me unbidden' and Bolas replies 'So you claim, but I don't believe you.' No Wizards source independently settles priority.

Ajani in Lorwyn Eclipsed Episode 2: 'we don't know whether his spark is intact'. The full Reality Fracture main story (10 episodes, Aug 31-Sep 10 2026) mentions Bolas 4 times (Ravnica memory, Meditation Realm craft, Echoverse exclusion) and never addresses his spark or location. Lorwyn Eclipsed Episodes 1 and 3-7, its Planeswalker's Guide and Secrets of Strixhaven Episode 1 contain no Bolas mention. The question remains open as of the 2026-10-30 evidence cutoff.
